text: 0271 keyed its index on the first six checks; where three were E-with-E repeats, millions of pairs were counted, never verified.
41,986 settings, repeats tested as equal carved letters, the index on informative checks only; 0271's lone length-10 fit is gone.
No key word on K4 or any of 50 shuffles; plants 12/12. One count-only cell, A25 Beaufort, sits above every shuffle: replicated as F14.2b.
